method.scope: Whole fresh processes, including startup and cached file I/O
method.memory: Linux wait4 peak RSS in KiB for the single child process
method.correctness: Stable emitted image hash within each variant; identical formatted output across every run and variant
method.order: Case order and compiler order alternate by round; variant order is offset between cases
method.outlier_policy: Retain all successful measured runs; abort on any failure
method.limitations: Two tools from the compiler repository, not a game/database workload. Shared-host timing does not establish controlled-hardware performance.
